source_refs.note: 7. Pressure due to Particle Collisions: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: The pressure exerted by a gas on the walls of its container is due to the collisions of gas particles with the walls. The force exerted by the particles during collisions generates pressure.
